text: This is the hardest story in this part of the Bible. God told the Israelites to take Jericho, and the Bible says that the city and everything in it was destroyed, except Rahab and her family (Joshua 6:17, 21, 24). The game does not show or describe the fighting. It shows the march, the shout, and the wall falling, and ends with Rahab and her family brought out safe.
Many people ask how a loving God could command this. It is a good question to ask together. One thing the story says plainly is that Rahab, a foreigner of Jericho who trusted God, was saved.
